title: Smoke rings
description: A few perfect smoke rings floating up into a blue morning sky above a round green door and a flower box.

title: A hedge of dog-roses
description: A climbing dog-rose with pink flowers, buds and a bumblebee, rising up the margin.

title: The secret mark
description: A small mysterious scratched sign glinting on shiny green paintwork beside a brass knob.

title: Hoods on the pegs
description: A row of wooden pegs holding exactly thirteen coloured hoods (count them): one dark green, one scarlet, two blue, two purple, one grey, one brown, one white, two yellow, one pale green, and one sky-blue with a long silver tassel.

title: The doorbell
description: An old brass bell-pull swinging beside a round door, with motion lines as it rings.

title: Tea for thirteen
description: A crowded tea table: seed-cake, raspberry jam, apple tart, mince pies, cheese, a cold chicken, pickles and a big teapot.

title: Flying plates
description: Plates and cups tossed up in an arc over a sink, none of them broken, with soap bubbles.

title: Instruments
description: A tall stack of musical instruments: a harp, fiddles, flutes, a drum and a viol, tied with ribbon.

title: A dwarf's hood and beard
description: A long forked beard tucked into a belt under a sky-blue hood with a silver tassel.

title: The old map
description: An old parchment map with mountains, a forest, a lake and a red arrow, its corners curling.

title: The key
description: A small silver key with an odd ward on a fine chain, lying on parchment.

title: A candle at bedtime
description: A candlestick and a nightcap on a bedside table by a round window, a moon outside.

title: Breakfast left behind
description: A tailpiece of a teacup, a half-eaten slice of toast and a pocket-handkerchief left on a table.

title: The note under the clock
description: A folded note tucked under a mantel clock, a dusty breakfast plate beside it.

title: Running down the lane
description: A tiny figure hurrying down a country lane past hedges, without hat or walking stick, a mill in the distance.

title: Packs and ponies
description: A heap of travel packs, bedrolls and saddlebags beside a grazing pony.

title: Rain
description: Slanting rain over dripping foxgloves and ferns, a toadstool sheltering a beetle.

title: Mutton on a spit
description: Meat roasting on a long spit over a crackling fire, sparks rising.

title: Ale jugs
description: Enormous rough jugs of ale and a battered cooking pot, sized for giants.

title: The squeaking purse
description: A lumpy leather purse with an alarmed face drawn in its stitching, as if squeaking.

title: Stone at sunrise
description: The first rays of sunrise over a woodland clearing, three tall grey boulders shaped like hunched figures, a robin on one.

title: Swords from the cave
description: Three old swords and a knife laid on a cloak, one with runes on the blade.

title: Troll's gold buried
description: A tailpiece of a small pot of gold coins half-buried under tree roots, a spade beside it.

title: The zigzag path
description: A narrow zigzag path dropping down a steep ravine edged with pines and heather.

title: Lanterns in the trees
description: Lanterns hanging among birch and pine branches at dusk, with fireflies.

title: A singing elf
description: A tiny laughing figure in green sitting on a branch with a harp, silhouetted against a twilight sky.

title: The hall of fire
description: A great stone hearth with a long fire and benches before it, a harp leaning against a pillar.

title: Runes on a blade
description: Close-up of an old sword hilt and blade engraved with flowing runes.

title: Moon-letters
description: A crescent moon above a parchment where faint silver letters glow.

title: New horseshoes
description: Fresh horseshoes, nails and a farrier's hammer on an anvil.

title: Midsummer morning
description: A tailpiece of a waterfall, pine sprigs and a sprig of midsummer flowers in morning light.

title: The mountain path
description: A thin path climbing between crags, a pony with packs, clouds below.

title: Lightning
description: A jagged fork of lightning splitting a dark sky over peaks.

title: A thrown boulder
description: A great boulder flying through misty air with a puff of spray, comic rather than scary.

title: A dry cave
description: The low mouth of a sheltering cave with packs stacked inside.

title: Goblin tools
description: Crude goblin hammers, tongs, chains and a cogwheel on a forge bench, in red light.

title: Goblin machinery
description: Clanking wooden wheels, chains, pulleys and a bellows in a red-lit cavern, no figures.

title: Glowing blades
description: Two sword blades glowing pale blue in the dark.

title: A lost button
description: A tailpiece of a single brass button lying in the dark on a cave floor beside a dropped candle stub.

title: Alone in the dark
description: A tiny glow of a small sword in total darkness, a faint outline of a hand.

title: A ring on the floor
description: A plain gold ring lying on a tunnel floor, catching a faint glint.

title: The black lake
description: A still black underground lake with a rocky island and a little boat.

title: Pale eyes
description: Two round pale glowing eyes in the dark over black water, mysterious not scary.

title: Stalactites
description: Dripping stalactites and stalagmites with tiny drops of water, running down the margin.

title: Riddle: roots and peak
description: A mountain with deep roots drawn beneath it and a cloud on its peak.

title: Riddle: wind
description: Leaves, dandelion seeds and a feather swirling on the wind.

title: Riddle: an egg
description: A speckled egg in a mossy nest.

title: Riddle: a fish
description: A silver fish swimming in dark water.

title: Riddle: time
description: An hourglass beside a crumbling stone and a tiny sapling.

title: A pocket
description: A waistcoat pocket with something round and golden peeking out.

title: Popped buttons
description: Brass buttons scattered on a stone doorstep in a crack of daylight.

title: Daylight at last
description: A tailpiece of sunlight bursting through a narrow rock crack, a few mountain flowers.

title: Sunlit slope
description: A sunny mountainside dell with heather, rocks and a blue sky.

title: Counting dwarves
description: Exactly thirteen coloured hoods (count them) in a row seen from behind, with one empty space at the end where the hobbit should be.

title: The scree slope
description: Loose stones tumbling down a steep slope towards pine trees.

title: Wolf eyes
description: Pairs of yellow eyes glinting between dark tree trunks, more mysterious than scary.

title: A flaming pine-cone
description: A burning pine-cone with blue and gold flames, trailing sparks.

title: A fir tree
description: A tall fir tree with someone's boots and a cloak dangling from a branch.

title: An eagle's talon
description: A great golden eagle's foot gently holding a small cloak.

title: The eyrie
description: A high rock ledge with a small fire, a nest of sticks and a view over miles of land.

title: Eagle feathers
description: A tailpiece of three golden-brown eagle feathers crossed with a sprig of pine.

title: The Carrock
description: A great flat-topped rock with carved steps standing in a river.

title: Clover and bees
description: Tall clover, thistles and foxgloves with enormous furry bees, running up the margin.

title: A giant bee
description: A huge furry bumblebee on a clover head, accurate and gentle.

title: Beehives
description: A row of straw bee skeps on a bench in a sunny garden.

title: Two at a time
description: Two coloured hoods peeking round a big wooden door.

title: Animals serving supper
description: Dogs on hind legs and a woolly sheep carrying trays of honey, cream and bread, gently funny.

title: Honey and cream
description: Wooden bowls of honey and cream with a honeycomb and a wooden spoon.

title: A bear's paw print
description: A large bear's paw print in moonlit grass by a gate.

title: Honey-cakes
description: A basket of twice-baked honey-cakes wrapped in a checked cloth.

title: The forest gate
description: Two leaning trees forming a dark arch over a path, ivy hanging down.

title: Ponies going home
description: A tailpiece of two ponies trotting away along a meadow path at sunset.

title: Forest trunks
description: Twisted dark tree trunks with moss, fungi and hanging cobwebs.

title: Black squirrels
description: Two black squirrels with bright eyes on a mossy branch.

title: The enchanted stream
description: A dark stream with a small boat tied on the far bank.

title: A sleeping dwarf
description: A stout dwarf in a pale green hood, fast asleep and snoring on a stretcher of branches.

title: Velvet butterflies
description: Velvety black butterflies with purple sheen in sunlight above leaves.

title: An elvish feast
description: Torches and long tables in a forest clearing seen through trees, lights twinkling.

title: Naming the sword
description: A small sword stuck point-down in the moss, gleaming, beside a broken strand of web.

title: Silk bundles
description: Bundles wrapped in grey silk hanging from a branch, comic and not scary.

title: A cross spider
description: A big round cartoonish spider with many eyes looking cross and confused, not frightening.

title: Webs and dew
description: Strands of silvery web with dewdrops running down the margin.

title: A broken web
description: A tailpiece of a torn cobweb between two twigs with a small stone caught in it.

title: Bridge to the halls
description: A narrow stone bridge over a dark river to great carved cave doors with torches.

title: A dungeon door
description: A heavy wooden cell door with an iron grille and a lantern beside it.

title: The butler's keys
description: A great iron ring of keys on a belt.

title: Wine flagons
description: Two empty wine flagons and goblets tipped over on a table.

title: Stacked barrels
description: A tall stack of wine barrels in a vaulted cellar, running down the margin.

title: Straw and a lid
description: A barrel with straw poking out and a lid being hammered on.

title: The trapdoor
description: An open trapdoor in a cellar floor with water glinting below.

title: River and reeds
description: Rushing river water with reeds, a heron and a barrel bobbing past.

title: Barrels ashore
description: A tailpiece of three wet barrels resting on a pebbly shore with reeds.

title: Town on stilts
description: Wooden houses on tall stilts over a misty lake, seen from the shore.

title: A lake boat
description: A long wooden boat with oars and a lantern moored to a post.

title: Old songs
description: A harp and a scroll of old songs on a bench, a candle beside them.

title: A feast
description: A great platter of fish, bread and fruit with goblets on a long table.

title: A dreadful cold
description: A handkerchief, a steaming mug and a pair of slippers by a fire.

title: Flags and lanterns
description: Bunting, flags and lanterns strung along a wooden walkway.

title: The lonely mountain
description: A tailpiece of a single distant mountain across water, a few birds.

title: Desolation
description: Bare, burned tree stumps and stones climbing the margin, one brave green shoot.

title: Ruined town
description: Broken towers and houses of a ruined town in a valley.

title: The grassy ledge
description: A small grassy ledge with packs, a smooth rock wall behind.

title: Chipping at rock
description: Picks and mattocks lying beside a scratched rock wall.

title: A thrush and a snail
description: A speckled thrush with a snail beside a grey stone (the snail motif).

title: The keyhole
description: A keyhole revealed in smooth rock, lit red-gold by the setting sun.

title: Key and moss
description: A tailpiece of an old key lying on a mossy stone with a snail shell.

title: The long tunnel
description: A tunnel sloping downwards into a faint red glow, running down the margin.

title: Gold coins
description: A spill of gold coins, a crown and jewels catching warm light.

title: The two-handled cup
description: A large golden two-handled cup with engraved patterns.

title: A wisp of smoke
description: A curl of smoke and a few sparks rising from a dark cave mouth.

title: One open eye
description: A single huge red-gold eye half-open, a reflection of gold in it, majestic not frightening.

title: The bare patch
description: A jewel-crusted dragon's belly with one bare patch where a gem is missing.

title: Scorched ledge
description: Scorched grass and smoking stones on a mountain ledge.

title: Treasure tailpiece
description: A tailpiece of goblets, coins and a jewelled crown in a small heap.

title: A flickering torch
description: A torch with a small flickering flame in darkness.

title: The great white gem
description: A large white gem glowing like a star with soft rays of light.

title: A mail-coat
description: A small shining silver mail-coat laid out with a plumed helmet.

title: Carved pillars
description: Tall carved dwarf pillars and broken stairs running up the margin.

title: Old dwarf tools
description: Ancient hammers, chisels and lanterns on a dusty workbench.

title: A raven's lookout
description: An old stone look-out post above a river valley with a raven perched on it.

title: Helmet and shield
description: A tailpiece of a dwarf helmet resting on a small round shield.

title: Bells and lanterns
description: Bells ringing and lanterns swinging on wooden posts, running down the margin.

title: Fiery sky
description: A red glow over dark water at night, sparks drifting down.

title: A thrush whispering
description: A speckled thrush perched on a gloved hand beside a great bow.

title: The black arrow
description: A single black-feathered arrow, its point gleaming.

title: Steam over the lake
description: Great clouds of steam and sparks rising over a dark lake, no figures.

title: Shelter by the shore
description: Tents, campfires and cooking pots on a lake shore at dawn.

title: Bow and quiver
description: A tailpiece of a yew longbow and quiver lying among reeds.

title: An old raven
description: An ancient, bedraggled raven on a stone, looking wise.

title: Birds on the wing
description: Flocks of birds streaming up the margin against grey cloud.

title: Building the wall
description: Stones stacked in a rough wall with a trowel and a bucket of mortar.

title: Banners in the valley
description: Banners and tents seen far below in a valley, small and distant.

title: A herald's horn
description: A brass horn with a tasselled cord resting on a stone.

title: Campfires at dusk
description: A tailpiece of three small campfires glowing at dusk under a crescent moon.

title: A rope over the wall
description: A knotted rope hanging down a stone wall under stars.

title: Stars and river
description: A starry sky above a winding river, running down the margin.

title: The gem unwrapped
description: A glowing white gem being unwrapped from a cloth on a camp table by lantern light.

title: A wizard's hat
description: A tall pointed blue hat and a wooden staff leaning in a tent corner.

title: Lantern and cloak
description: A tailpiece of a lantern and a folded cloak by a tent flap.

title: A dwarf army's shields
description: A row of round dwarf shields and mattocks, glinting.

title: Storm clouds
description: Dark, rolling storm clouds with shafts of light, running up the margin.

title: A lookout hill
description: A rocky hilltop with a small figure in a helmet watching, the valley below.

title: The eagles come
description: A line of great eagles silhouetted against gold-lit clouds.

title: A dented helmet
description: A small dented helmet lying in the heather with a stone beside it.

title: After the storm
description: A tailpiece of a sprig of heather and a fallen eagle feather in clear light.

title: Candle in a tent
description: A single candle burning beside a folded blue hood with a silver tassel.

title: A memorial stone
description: A plain stone in a quiet hall with flowers laid upon it.

title: Two small chests
description: Two small wooden chests of treasure strapped to a pony's saddle.

title: Spring blossom
description: Hawthorn and apple blossom on a branch, running down the margin.

title: Yule in the hall
description: Garlands, a Yule log and a long table in a timber hall, snow at the door.

title: The road home
description: A winding green road through spring hedges, running up the margin.

title: Pack and stick
description: A tailpiece of a travel pack, a walking stick and a sprig of spring flowers.

title: Elves singing
description: Lanterns among valley trees at night with stars and a waterfall.

title: Digging up gold
description: A spade and a pot of gold coins dug up from under a tree's roots.

title: The auction
description: Furniture, clocks, umbrellas and chairs spread across a garden lawn with a sale sign that has no letters.

title: Teaspoons missing
description: A velvet-lined box with several silver teaspoons missing.

title: Writing memoirs
description: A writing desk with a quill, an inkpot and a growing stack of handwritten pages, a map pinned above.

title: A sword over the mantel
description: A small sword hanging over a mantelpiece beside a clock.

title: Tea for three
description: A teapot, three cups and a plate of cake by a fireside.

title: The round door again
description: A final tailpiece of a round green door with a brass knob, roses around it and a snail on the step.
